calcifin-stim.name: Calcifin Stim
calcifin-stim.description: Hardens skin, fortifying against damage while restricting movement.

carpet-bomb.name: Carpet Bomb
carpet-bomb.description: Ordis drops bombs in a line from your position to the beacon you placed.

charamote-bait.name: Charamote Bait
charamote-bait.description:
This bait is synthesized from complex hexophenol that is known to attract Charamotes, a Servofish found in Orb Vallis cave hotspots.

Obtained from The Business in Fortuna (Venus).

charger-specter.name: Charger Specter
charger-specter.description: Deploys a CHARGER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

cipher.name: Cipher
cipher.description: Single-use device used for auto-hacking the lockdown control panels.

citrine-antitoxin.name: Citrine Antitoxin
citrine-antitoxin.description: This is a moderately effective antitoxin.

clem-clone.name: Clem Clone
clem-clone.description: Deploys a clone of Clem to fight for you.

clotra-stim.name: Clotra Stim
clotra-stim.description: Revives a target that is bleeding out, and provides a bonus revive to any allies in range.

codex-scanner.name: Codex Scanner
codex-scanner.description: Samples a target of interest for later analysis in your Codex (25 charges).

condroc-echo-lure.name: Condroc Echo-Lure
condroc-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Condroc with life-like animal calls. Condroc inhabit the Plains of Eidolon.

condroc-pheromone-oota.name: Condroc Pheromone Oota
condroc-pheromone-oota.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Condroc.

corrupted-bombard-specter.name: Corrupted Bombard Specter
corrupted-bombard-specter.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED BOMBARD unit to fight for you.

corrupted-heavy-gunner-specter.name: Corrupted Heavy Gunner Specter
corrupted-heavy-gunner-specter.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED HEAVY GUNNER unit to fight for you.

corrupted-lancer-specter.name: Corrupted Lancer Specter
corrupted-lancer-specter.description: Deploys a CORRUPTED LANCER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

cosmic-specter.name: Cosmic Specter
cosmic-specter.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.

cosmic-specter-regiment.name: Cosmic Specter Regiment
cosmic-specter-regiment.description: An army composed of cosmic-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for four conflicts.

cryptilex-echo-lure.name: Cryptilex Echo-Lure
cryptilex-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Cryptilex with life-like animal calls.

cryptilex-pheromone-gland.name: Cryptilex Pheromone Gland
cryptilex-pheromone-gland.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Cryptilex.

cuthol-bait.name: Cuthol Bait
cuthol-bait.description:
This bait is composed of materials that are known to attract Cuthols, a fish found only in Plains of Eidolon pond hotspots during the night.

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth).
